page.layout: One text column, with marginal notes in the left margin. Running head above the column, page number at top left. The right-hand printed page is only a fragment at the edge of the scan and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: “abnegarent. Quibus & mox subdit, “versus Epistolæ finem. Visa est mihi “res digna consultatione, maxime “propter periclitantium numerum. “Multi enim omnis ætatis, omnis ordi-“nis, vtriusque sexus, etiam vocantur “in periculum, & vocabuntur. Neq; “enim Ciuitates tantùm, sed vicos, eti-“am atque agros, superstitionis istius “(ita Religionem Chriftianam ipse A-“theus appellat) contagio peruagata “est.] Neque tantùm verò Bythiniam, sed “& illi confinem Pontum repletam fuisse “hoc sæculo Christianis, qui Gentilis-“mum execrarentur, Lucianus in Pseu-“domante testatum reliquit; quod etiam “ex illa generali persecutione apparet, “cuius meminit Lib.3. cap.26.{n}Eufebius, vbi asserit: in “vnaquaque ciuitate sub Traiani Impe-“rio ac seditione populi excitata, grau-“em contra Christianos persequutio-“nis tempestatem commotam. Et ne pu-“temus defuisse in ipso Imperatoris ex-“ercitu, qui eandem Religionem profi-“tebantur: Christianum tunc temporis Nicepb. lib.3.ca.29.{o}Eustachium, siue Placidam dictum, in-“signem belli Ducem compertum est, qui

page.notes: Two printed lines in the right-hand page edge are not transcribed. The printed "Pseu-domante" is read as Pseudomante, and "Nicepb." is read as printed (possibly Nicephori). The hyphenated "A-theus" and "Pseu-domante" are kept with their printed hyphens. Paragraph continues onto the next page with "qui". The bracket in "est.]" is printed.
